Frequently asked questions

How do I bridge assets to or from the XRP Ledger?

Pick a destination and an amount, then review and sign one XRP Ledger payment. LumosCore chooses the route for you: NEAR Intents and THORChain both quote XRP to most destinations and whichever delivers more is the one used, while an Axelar interchain token you already hold goes by Axelar. The route that will carry it is named on the review before you sign.

Do I have to claim anything on the other side?

No. All three routes deliver to the address you give, with no second signature and no gas needed on arrival. That is different from Circle’s CCTP on the Stellar build, where an asset is burned on one chain and you redeem it on the other; nothing here works that way.

What if I close the tab?

Once the payment is signed and submitted, the route carries it whether or not the page is open — it is the XRP Ledger transaction that commits you, not the tab. If you close it before signing, nothing has happened and nothing is owed. NEAR Intents refunds to the same wallet that paid if a transfer cannot be completed.

Which bridges does LumosCore use here?

Three, and they are good at different things. NEAR Intents moves XRP to thirty-five networks and delivers the chain’s own token rather than a wrapped copy. Axelar moves the interchain tokens registered on the XRP Ledger, and is the only route to the XRPL EVM sidechain and to Hedera. THORChain overlaps the first on ten chains and adds Cosmos Hub, so where both can carry a transfer both are asked and the better price wins.

Which chains are supported?

Thirty-nine destinations. NEAR Intents reaches thirty-five of them — including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, TON, Tron and Stellar — and carries XRP only. Axelar carries the interchain tokens registered here, and reaches the XRPL EVM sidechain and Hedera, which nothing else on this page does. THORChain adds Cosmos Hub. The lists are fetched live from each network rather than written into the page, so none of them can go stale.

What are the cross-chain fees?

LumosCore takes 0.2% of the amount, or 0.1% if you hold 250,000 LUMOS or more — the same rate as everywhere else on the site. Each route charges its own cost on top and each is shown before you sign: NEAR Intents takes a solver fee, Axelar charges destination gas quoted in XRP, and THORChain prices its swap into the amount you are quoted. The XRP Ledger’s own transaction fee is a fraction of a drop and is paid to the ledger, never to us.

Can I bridge my own XRP Ledger token?

Only if Axelar has registered it as an interchain token — that route carries the assets on its own registry, such as WETH, WBTC, USDC and SHX, and nothing else. NEAR Intents and THORChain both take XRP alone. So an arbitrary issued token cannot be bridged from this page, and the destination list narrows to Axelar’s the moment you select one that can.

How the bridge works

Cross-chain transfers via Axelar.
01
Pick source and destination
Choose the chains you're bridging between (the XRP Ledger and your destination network), then the asset and the amount you want to move.
02
The best route is selected automatically
Transfers route through Axelar, so you receive the destination asset directly.
03
Confirm and sign once
Your wallet signs the source-chain transaction. The bridge locks on the source side and releases the matching asset on the destination side.
04
You stay in custody
No central bridge holds your funds. Assets move pool-to-pool and settle straight to your destination wallet.
